sections.heading: Places in town
sections.body: *En ville* (in town) you'll find: *la boulangerie* (bakery), *la pharmacie*, *le supermarché*, *la banque*, *la poste* (post office), *le marché* (market), *le restaurant*, *le café*, *la gare* (train station), *l'arrêt de bus* (bus stop), *la mairie* (town hall), *le parc*, *le musée* (museum), *l'église* (church), *le quartier* (neighbourhood).

sections.heading: Is there…? Il y a
sections.body: *Il y a* means "there is / there are" and doesn't change in the plural: *Il y a une pharmacie près d'ici ?* (Is there a pharmacy near here?) *Dans mon quartier, il y a deux boulangeries.* Negative: *Il n'y a pas de banque.*

sections.heading: Where is it? Prepositions of place
sections.body:
- *dans* — in: *dans la rue* (in the street)
- *sur* — on: *sur la place* (on the square)
- *sous* — under
- *devant* — in front of; *derrière* — behind
- *entre* — between: *entre la banque et la poste*
- *à côté de* — next to; *en face de* — opposite
- *près de* — near; *loin de* — far from
- *à gauche (de)* — on the left (of); *à droite (de)* — on the right (of)

With *de*, remember the contractions: *à côté du café*, *en face de la gare*, *près de l'église*, *loin des magasins*.

- *ici* — here; *là* — there; *là-bas* — over there.

sections.heading: Chez
sections.body: *Chez* means "at (or to) someone's place": *chez moi* (at my place, at home), *chez Léa*, *chez le médecin* (at the doctor's), *Je vais chez le coiffeur.* (I'm going to the hairdresser's.)

examples: Il y a une pharmacie près d'ici ?
Is there a pharmacy near here?
La boulangerie est à côté de la banque.
The bakery is next to the bank.
La poste est en face de la gare.
The post office is opposite the station.
Dans mon quartier, il y a deux boulangeries.
In my neighbourhood there are two bakeries.
Il n'y a pas de supermarché ici.
There's no supermarket here.
Le musée est sur la place, à gauche.
The museum is on the square, on the left.
Le marché est loin d'ici ?
Is the market far from here?
Le café est entre la banque et la poste.
The café is between the bank and the post office.
Je t'attends devant le cinéma.
I'll wait for you in front of the cinema.
Le parc est derrière l'église.
The park is behind the church.
Ce soir, on dîne chez moi.
Tonight we're having dinner at my place.
Je vais chez le médecin.
I'm going to the doctor's.
La gare est là-bas, à droite.
The station is over there, on the right.
